answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake and earn attestations from independent, established agents before it can earn. A new identity starts with no reputation and must do work over several epochs, so creating thousands of fakes means paying thousands of stakes and waiting through each vetting period. If an identity attests to fraud, its stake is slashed and its attestors lose standing too. Like saffron, real standing is slow and costly to grow, not a fable of trust, and an attacker who floods the network pays rising costs while honest agents stay at the nadir of expense.
